text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Summer Training Camp" starts today! 
Intensive training begins to hone our 
skills.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While the students, including Narita 
Brian, boarded the bus one after 
another...

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian-san, after your glorious run 
through the Classic Triple Crown, could we 
get a word from you?!

text_block_list.name: Journalist
text_block_list.text:
Are you keeping the "Triple Crown 
Umamusume" Symboli Rudolf in your sights 
after all!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Do you think you can surpass the wall of 
GⅠ victories set by the "Emperor"!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The public's fervor for Narita Brian's 
challenge for the Classic Triple Crown 
never cooled; rather, it only grew 
alongside diverse expectations.
choice_data_list: Go ahead and get on the bus first.
You go ahead and get on the bus first.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text: Wait, what!? Brian-san!? Brian-san!!
choice_data_list: I'll handle the press over here!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha, it's getting wild out there.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you have time for this? What 
about your duties as student council 
president?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I tried to take the lead at first to do 
something about it myself, though.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, Air Groove scolded me, 
saying things would only get too heated if 
I stepped in."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. Indeed, the press strangely kept 
bringing up your name.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Voices comparing me to you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Want to actually compare them?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch. Dangler a carrot in front of my face 
like that... that's always your move, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
When you dragged me onto the student 
council, you said, 'I'll accept your 
challenge,' yet you've done nothing but 
stand on the sidelines.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Even while enrolled in the Twinkle Series, 
she seemed to keep her distance somehow.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I have yet to see you look truly serious.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
However, once I pull up alongside you, I 
won't let you escape.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely drag you into a fair and 
serious fight.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hoh. Then I shall accept your resolve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sun blazed hotter than in usual years. 
Inside the bus, the curtains were drawn 
tight as if trying to shut it out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, their oaths had been sworn.
